title: Team-level cost allocation rollup in the economics read model
spec: Costs are attributed per invocation and per user, but operators cannot answer 'what did each team spend this period'. Add a team-level cost allocation rollup to the economics service: aggregate ledger spend by the owning team (legacy records without a team fall back to the local team), expose the rollup through the read model / public state, and unit-test the aggregation including the legacy fallback.
